tasks.message: Create a test Account identity named enact-golden-acme, issue it a key, rotate that key once, and confirm the old key is revoked. Use our own dev/test Account stack at https://$PRISM_DOMAIN with the shared key in PRISM_API_KEY (already set in your environment); send X-Source-Repository and X-Source-Commit on every write, then read the configuration back through the API and show that it matches what you wrote.

must_include: the configuration read back through the Account HTTP API, matching what was written
X-Source-Repository and X-Source-Commit sent on the write
the identity id and key ids (redacted)
the old key shown as revoked after rotation
must_not: uses AWS credentials or the AWS CLI
writes to the soofi-safavi or any production environment
reports a check as passing that it did not run
prints a secret, API key or token value
